text:
I do not want you
to descend like night;
I want not fulfillment
but revelation.
Descend upon my eyes
swift as rain.
Like a furious lightning bolt,
burst in with a crack
while things remain
motionless in the light.
For I do not want a sweet,
lingering caress,
but that powerful
embrace in which I break.

translation.title: I Do Not Want You to Descend Like Night...
